panels.description: Sites whose latest reading is from yesterday or today.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t(team, name, des, fp) AS (VALUES (13,'Ibra',4500,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(12,'Al-Mudhaibi',1800,'Flow Meter (In - New Plant)%'),(20,'Masirah',1800,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(16,'Jalaan Bani Bu Ali',1200,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(17,'Jalaan Bani Bu Hassan',600,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(11,'Wadi Bani Khalid',500,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(21,'New Haima',450,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(14,'Bidiya',300,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(18,'Al-Kamil Wafi',250,'Flow Meter%Out%'),(15,'Al-Qabil',250,'Flow Meter%Out%')),
today AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS d),
fl AS (SELECT t.team, (x.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, sum(CASE WHEN x.is_override THEN x.reset_value ELSE x.daily_flow END) AS v FROM t JOIN user_customform f ON f.team_id = t.team AND f.is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.title_override,''), f.name) ILIKE t.fp JOIN user_flowmeterreadingdata x ON x.form_id = f.id WHERE x.datetime > now() - interval '31 days' AND x.datetime < now() GROUP BY 1, 2),
flv AS (SELECT fl.* FROM fl JOIN t ON t.team = fl.team WHERE fl.v BETWEEN 0 AND t.des * 5),
upto AS (SELECT f.team_id AS team, max((x.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date) AS d FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id IN (SELECT team FROM t) AND x.datetime < now() GROUP BY 1),
pw AS (SELECT f.team_id AS team, (x.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, sum(CASE WHEN x.is_override THEN x.reset_value ELSE x.daily_power END) AS v FROM user_powermeterreadingdata x JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = x.form_id WHERE f.team_id IN (SELECT team FROM t) AND f.is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.title_override,''), f.name) ILIKE 'Power Meter - %STP%' AND x.datetime > now() - interval '31 days' AND x.datetime < now() GROUP BY 1, 2),
se AS (SELECT flv.team, flv.day, pw.v AS kwh, flv.v AS m3 FROM flv JOIN pw ON pw.team = flv.team AND pw.day = flv.day WHERE flv.v > 0 AND pw.v > 0 AND pw.v / flv.v < 10),
lab AS (SELECT f.team_id AS team, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day,
  avg(l.result) FILTER (WHERE btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Ammonia Nitrogen') AS nh,
  avg(l.result) FILTER (WHERE btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Free and Residual Chlorine') AS cl,
  avg(l.result) FILTER (WHERE btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Nitrate Nitrogen') AS no3,
  avg(l.result) FILTER (WHERE btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'pH') AS ph,
  avg(l.result) FILTER (WHERE btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Aeration%' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume') AS sv
 FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id IN (SELECT team FROM t) AND l.time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '31 days' AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1, 2),
s AS (SELECT t.team, t.name, t.des, u.d AS up_to, (SELECT d FROM today) - 1 - u.d AS behind,
  (SELECT avg(v) FROM flv WHERE flv.team = t.team) AS flow30,
  (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(round(flv.v)::text, ''), ',' ORDER BY g.day) FROM generate_series((SELECT d FROM today) - 30, (SELECT d FROM today) - 1, interval '1 day') AS g(day) LEFT JOIN flv ON flv.team = t.team AND flv.day = g.day::date) AS series,
  (SELECT sum(kwh) / NULLIF(sum(m3), 0) FROM se WHERE se.team = t.team) AS se30,
  (SELECT avg(nh) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team) AS nh, (SELECT avg(cl) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team) AS cl, (SELECT avg(no3) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team) AS no3,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND COALESCE(nh, cl, ph, sv) IS NOT NULL) AS lab_n,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND COALESCE(nh, cl, ph, sv) IS NOT NULL AND (nh IS NULL OR nh < 5) AND (cl IS NULL OR cl BETWEEN 0.1 AND 0.5) AND (ph IS NULL OR (ph >= 6.5 AND ph < 8)) AND (sv IS NULL OR sv BETWEEN 400 AND 600)) AS lab_ok,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND lab.day > (SELECT d FROM today) - 7 AND nh >= 5) AS nh_out7,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND lab.day > (SELECT d FROM today) - 7 AND (cl < 0.1 OR cl > 0.5)) AS cl_out7,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND lab.day > (SELECT d FROM today) - 7 AND (ph < 6.5 OR ph >= 8)) AS ph_out7,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND lab.day > (SELECT d FROM today) - 7 AND (sv < 400 OR sv > 600)) AS sv_out7,
  (SELECT max(day) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team AND nh IS NOT NULL) AS nh_last,
  (SELECT bool_or(n >= 7 AND mn = mx AND mx > 0) FROM (SELECT count(no3) n, min(no3) mn, max(no3) mx FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team UNION ALL SELECT count(ph), min(ph), max(ph) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team UNION ALL SELECT count(nh), min(nh), max(nh) FROM lab WHERE lab.team = t.team) c) AS constant
 FROM t LEFT JOIN upto u ON u.team = t.team),
r AS (SELECT s.*, CASE
  WHEN up_to IS NULL OR behind > 3 OR constant THEN 'purple'
  WHEN behind > 1 OR flow30 > des OR nh_out7 >= 3 OR cl_out7 >= 3 OR ph_out7 >= 3 OR sv_out7 >= 3 OR (behind <= 1 AND (nh_last IS NULL OR nh_last < (SELECT d FROM today) - 3)) THEN 'amber'
  ELSE 'ok' END AS sev FROM s) SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE behind <= 1) || ' of ' || count(*) AS "Sites with readings up to yesterday or today" FROM r

panels.title: Sites

options.content: Dot = most severe attention rule: data more than 3 days behind, no data, or a lab value constant for 30 days (purple); data 2–3 days behind, above design, ammonia / chlorine / pH / SV30 outside limits on 3+ of the last 7 days, or no ammonia sample for 3+ days (amber). Within limits counts a day only if every parameter sampled that day is within its limit: ammonia < 5, chlorine 0.1–0.5, pH 6.5–8, SV30 400–600 mL/L.
